$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THE BRAND.
This one file renames and re-skins BOTH deliverables:
1. the marketing site in apps/web (imported via @scheduler/brand)
2. the self-hosted application image built by infra/overlay (read by apply-brand.mjs)
The product name below is a PLACEHOLDER. It was not chosen; it is a legible stand-in
so the site is demoable before naming is settled. See docs/07-naming.md.
To rename the whole product: change `name` and `domain` here, then run `pnpm brand:apply`.
Nothing else in either codebase hardcodes the product name.
name: Kolo
tagline: Run your whole social calendar from one place
description: Schedule, publish and measure posts across every network you use, from a single calendar — with your own AI agents doing the drafting.

app.$comment: Where the deployed scheduling application lives. Must be final before OAuth app registration — see docs/03-oauth-app-registration.md.

upstream.$comment: AGPL compliance: the source we build from, and where our modified source is published. See docs/06-agpl-compliance.md.

colors.$comment: Dark-first palette. `primary` and `accent` are the two that carry the brand; everything else is neutral scaffolding shared with the app overlay.

fonts.$comment: Both are Google Fonts, SIL Open Font Licence — free for commercial use, self-hosted by next/font so there is no third-party request at runtime.

legal.$comment: Fill before launch. Several social platforms require a reachable legal entity, a live privacy policy and terms URL during app review.
